meta.title: Draft project: cancel it from the menu
gaps: Verify that the cancelled prepared draft is removed from the Drafts list.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the cancelled prepared draft is removed from the Drafts list.

steps.note: Open the prepared draft project directly, as required for prepared-state cases.
Open the draft project's menu and choose the Cancel Event action.
Verify that choosing Cancel Event opens its confirmation dialog.
Confirm cancellation using the dialog's Cancel Event control.
Verify that Procol reports the cancellation succeeded.
